examples.japanese: ⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{屋根|やね}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{壊|こわ}れてしまった→壊れる：00791_kowareru⟧。
examples.english: The roof was damaged by the typhoon.

notes:
{屋根|やね} refers to the roof of a building.

WORD STRUCTURE:
{屋|や} (house) + {根|ね} (root/base) - the "base" covering of a house.

TYPES OF ROOFS:
- ⟦{瓦|かわら}→瓦：03902_kawara⟧{屋根|やね}: tiled roof (traditional Japanese)
- ⟦{茅葺き|かやぶき}→茅葺き：27791_kayabuki⟧{屋根|やね}: thatched roof
- ⟦{三角|さんかく}→三角：04177_sankaku⟧{屋根|やね}: triangular/gabled roof

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {屋根|やね}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{直|なお}す→直す：00869_naosu⟧: to fix the roof
- {屋根|やね}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{登|のぼ}る→登る：00660_noboru⟧: to climb onto the roof
- {屋根|やね}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{落|お}ちる→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧: to fall from the roof

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{屋根裏|やねうら}→屋根裏：15854_yaneura⟧: attic
- {屋根|やね}⟦{瓦|かわら}→瓦：03902_kawara⟧: roof tile

EXPRESSION:
⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧{屋根|やね}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{下|した}→下：00670_shita⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{住|す}む→住む：00673_sumu⟧: to live under the same roof (together)
